valid.name: concat() outside any loop - not flagged
valid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; items.concat(more);

valid.name: user-defined concat() on a non-array type inside a loop - not flagged (identity is resolved, not name-matched)
valid.code: class Rope { concat(other: Rope): Rope { return other; } } declare const ropes: Rope[]; declare const seed: Rope; let acc = seed; const n = ropes.length; for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) { acc = acc.concat(ropes[i] ?? seed); }

valid.name: concat.call() indirection - owned by direct-invocation-only, resolves to CallableFunction.call not Array.concat
valid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; for (const id of ids) { items.concat.call(items, more); }

valid.name: concat.apply() indirection - owned by direct-invocation-only
valid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; for (const id of ids) { items.concat.apply(items, [more]); }

valid.name: helper's concat() called from both inside and outside a loop - not provably per-iteration, not flagged
valid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; function helper() { items.concat(more); } helper(); for (const id of ids) { helper(); }

valid.name: helper referenced as a value (not only called) - unprovable, not flagged
valid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; function helper() { items.concat(more); } const ref = helper; for (const id of ids) { ref(); }

invalid.name: concat() inside for loop - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) { items.concat(more); }

invalid.name: concat() inside while loop - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; let i = 0; while (i < 3) { items.concat(more); i += 1; }

invalid.name: concat() inside do...while loop - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; let i = 0; do { items.concat(more); i += 1; } while (i < 3);

invalid.name: concat() inside for...of loop - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; for (const id of ids) { items.concat(more); }

invalid.name: concat() inside for...in loop - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const rec: Record<string, number>; for (const key in rec) { items.concat(more); }

invalid.name: computed literal key evades name matching but not signature resolution - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; for (const id of ids) { items['concat'](more); }

invalid.name: const-held method name evades name matching but not signature resolution - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; declare const key: 'concat'; for (const id of ids) { items[key](more); }

invalid.name: forEach callback is a loop body - flagged (LoopContext, not syntactic loop keywords)
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; ids.forEach((id) => { items.concat(more); });

invalid.name: map callback is a loop body - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; ids.map((id) => { return items.concat(more); });

invalid.name: helper function's only call site is inside a loop - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; function helper() { items.concat(more); } for (const id of ids) { helper(); }

invalid.name: const arrow-function helper's only call site is inside a loop - flagged
invalid.code: declare const items: number[]; declare const more: number[]; declare const ids: number[]; const helper = () => { items.concat(more); }; for (const id of ids) { helper(); }
